about: compare.mts --budgets for the perf workflow (.github/workflows/perf.yml) on GitHub's ubuntu-latest runner: per scenario/metric/statistic change (%) that counts. A change must also clear the range test (every candidate run outside the baseline runs' range, 5 runs a side). Thresholds are about twice the largest A/A median delta, with a 3% floor at p50 and 5% at p99. Recalibrate with the perf-aa label when the runner image or Node changes.

calibration.host/real-play: 2026-11-07, ubuntu-latest (AMD EPYC 7763, 4 vCPU), Node 22.23.4, main at bedca2b, two A/A rounds of 5+5 interleaved real-play runs (perf-aa on #285, run 42340497821 attempts 1 and 2): |median delta| p50 <= 0.8%, p99 <= 1.9% on every row; run-to-run spread 0.8-14.5% (one slow first baseline run in round 1). About 4.5 min a round.
